title: Unicode watermarking / homoglyph signature in source code
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin ai-fingerprint observed rules
description:
Detects zero-width characters (U+200B/200C/200D, or a mid-file U+FEFF), a curated set of Cyrillic/Greek characters substituted inside an otherwise-Latin identifier (homoglyph/IDN-homograph pattern), or curly/smart quotes (a Python SyntaxError as a string delimiter, so any occurrence sits inside a string literal's content or a comment). Mechanical, high-precision signals typical of text copy-pasted from a chat UI or a deliberate steganographic watermark.

Aggregated from 1 fingerprint hit(s) across 1 file(s). Sample paths: apps/foo/bar.py.
